title.narrative: Carbon Initiative for Development Readiness Fund

description.narrative:
"The Ci-Dev Readiness Fund is part of the Ci-Dev initiative which aims at utilizing carbon market finance to play an important role in transforming quality of life for poor people in least developed countriescomma as well as reducing carbon emissions to improve environmental conditions. It will do this by supporting the development of projects with high development benefitscomma such as making clean energy and other low carbon technologies more affordable for poor peoplecomma and by using the robust verification of the carbon market to deliver results based financing for the distribution of poverty reducing technologies.
The Ci-Dev Readiness Fund plans to achieve its objectives through four potential outputscomma which are expected to increase the success of governmentscomma financial institutionscomma private sector and civil society organizations to access carbon finance. These are: (i) developing new methodologies so that community and household projects can receive carbon market finance and that are approved for use internationally by the clean development mechanism (CDM) Executive Board; (ii) improving the capability and skills of communitiescomma private sector and government to develop carbon market projects using these new methodologiescomma and access the necessary funding for their implementation; (iii) developing and demonstrating business models for the practical use of new methodologiescomma so reducing perceptions of project riskcomma as these methodologies are untested they are considered riskier by project developers. Local financiers are unused to the business models or the technologies and so doubt the reliability of returns for such projects. In additioncomma less developed countries lack the experience of getting projects registered in the carbon marketcomma and are understandably nervous to try to use these new methodologies; and (iv) to use Results Based Financing to purchase carbon credits through the CDM for projects with high development benefits that use the new methodologiescomma which will be met through the related Ci-Dev Financing Fund."
